comment: 35yo female, asymptomatic, confirmed germline CDKN1B pathogenic variant on diagnostic panel after father's clinical-phenotype workup (primary hyperparathyroidism + corticotroph pituitary adenoma at age 55) led to MEN4 diagnosis.
